title: Loading arm estimates
frame: game body frame: +x forward, +y right, +z down, metres from aircraft root; conventional arms in inches per the source datum

conventions.delta_x_m_est_minus_pub: + means our estimate is FORWARD of the published arm
conventions.delta_in_est_minus_pub: + means our estimate is AFT of the published arm (source sign)
conventions.conversion: body_x = datum_body_x - arm_in*0.0254 (arms +aft); Beaver: body_x = datum_body_x + arm_in*0.0254 (arms +fwd)
